text:
as no sabes it that pasa
te parece the night más oscura

dentro of the vaso of cristal
and ya no tienes miedo
a that salgan
		the sueños a morderte,

that están seguros in his puesto.
as no sabes it that pasa

no quieres ver it that te ronda
sobre the giro of the day
and ya no
		temes ni the flecha,

ni the color, ni the llaga
of the luz that nos pesa.
and as
		pues no sabes

ni it that pasa ni it that is queda
no te angustia the flower
that
		allí in his rama temblorosa

lejos of ti, puesto that no the miras,
is está quedando of ti
		sola.

no sabes it that pasa
porque of ti no sabe nada nada.


as no is sabe what color tiene God
-¿será blanco and blue as
		este libro,

or rojo and púrpura as the ocaso,
or amarillo and rosado of the
		aurora,

verde tal vez as este mar,
as the cinta, as are the hojas?-

		Ay, that God sin color is me desliza

and is me queda gris as ceniza.
Ceniza gris, God gris me
		gusta:

gris of pensar it permanente,
gris of llover, of transitar
		words,

gris of pasar the rueda,
gris of torcer the hilo of the tardes

		and of mirar it that nos queda.

and as no is saben the colores
that aquí and allí nos dejan in
		the mano

temblorosos of fines the adioses.
but is that ni tú, ni I,
		ni aquél,

ni nadie, ni cualquiera
sabemos it that pasa or it that queda.
